_note: Dates and the shared draft banner for /coach/privacy and /coach/terms. They live here rather than in the two page files because the banner is one paragraph that must read identically on both pages, and a paragraph typed twice is a paragraph that drifts. Same reasoning as ASSESSMENT_CARD_COPY in components/coach/PriceGrid.tsx.
_effectiveDateNote: CalOPPA (Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code §22575(b)(4)) requires the privacy policy to carry an effective date, so this is a REAL DATE and not a build-time new Date(). Update `lastUpdated` on any edit; update `effectiveDate` only when something material changes, and say what changed in the 'Changes to this page' section. The two documents have independent dates on purpose: editing the lesson policies should not silently restate the privacy policy as new.
_draftNoticeNote: REMOVE THIS BANNER ONLY WHEN A CALIFORNIA ATTORNEY HAS ACTUALLY REVIEWED BOTH PAGES. Deleting it because the pages read confidently would be the whole problem. It is deliberately the first thing on each page rather than a footnote: a reader relying on either document deserves to know it has not been reviewed before they rely on it, not after.
